item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of Abiy clearly disclosing the full tradeoffs of the currency reform or other major policy reversals to the public.\nI found no strong evidence that the government self-corrected on the Merawi killings through an independent, public, accountable process.\nThe record instead shows partial compliance in technocratic economic policy and repeated concealment/denial in politically sensitive areas.","evidence":[{"title":"AP: Abiy says he has no intention of going to war with Somalia","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/","summary":"Abiy publicly denied war intent, framed peace as mutually beneficial, and later the Ankara Declaration in December matched that de-escalatory line. This is the best 2024 evidence of honoring a public restraint commitment.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.2"]},{"title":"IMF: Ethiopia reaches staff-level agreement on first ECF review","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/09/27/pr-24348-ethiopia-imf-reaches-agreement-on-the-first-review-of-the-extended-credit-facility","summary":"the IMF said the reform program was advancing well, the exchange-rate gap had largely closed, and disruption was limited. This supports a limited reading that the government followed through on a major formal economic commitment.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.3","7B.5"]},{"title":"IMF: Executive Board completes first review under ECF","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-10-18","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/18/pr-24383-ethiopia-imf-completes-the-1st-review-under-the-ecf-arrangement","summary":"Ethiopia met all quantitative performance criteria and most structural benchmarks, showing strong formal compliance with the IMF program. This is substantial evidence of commitment-keeping in the macroeconomic domain.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.3","7B.5"]},{"title":"Ethiopian Justice Minister Briefs Diplomats about Transitional Justice Policy Implementation","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-12-14","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876","summary":"the government said the transitional-justice policy is built around accountability, truth-seeking, conditional amnesty, reconciliation, and institutional reform after nationwide consultation. This is official commitment language, though still roadmap rhetoric rather than proof of delivery.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"Ethiopia to Pursue Transitional Justice Through Independent Justice Process","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-06-13","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4596260","summary":"the state minister said the government was committed to a neutral and professional transitional-justice process and to avoiding interference. This is weak but real evidence of a stated non-opportunistic commitment.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6"]},{"title":"Ethiopia 2024 Freedom in the World / CECOE rerun observation","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2025","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-world/2025 and https://cecoe.org/download/final-observation-report-on-the-outstanding-and-reelections-of-the-sixth-general-elections-held-in-benishangul-gumuz-afar-somali-and-central-ethiopia-regions-in-june-24-2024/","summary":"Freedom House said some June 2024 legislative/regional elections were peaceful and credible according to AU observers, and CECOE described the reruns as transparent enough for systematic observation. This is narrow evidence that not every formal process was manipulated.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.2"]},{"title":"Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland’s Red Sea port","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-01-01","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/","summary":"the Berbera MOU tied port access to possible naval use and possible recognition/concessions, which reads as leverage-seeking and escalatory rather than a careful, stable commitment. This is strong evidence of opportunistic bargaining.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.3","7B.7"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s PM defends currency float amid inflation concerns","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-s-PM-defends-currency-float-amid-inflation-concerns-47541564/","summary":"Abiy said calling the move a devaluation was wrong and insisted it was only meant to close the official/black-market gap. That is a defensive reframing of a painful policy, not a candid admission of tradeoffs.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.2","7B.3"]},{"title":"Ethiopia rejects allegations its forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-15","url":"https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/15/ethiopia-rejects-allegations-its-forces-massacred-civilians-as-the-west-urges-an-investigation/","summary":"officials denied Merawi massacre allegations while rights monitors said at least 45 civilians were killed and called for an investigation. This is evidence of denial in the face of contrary reporting, not forthright accountability.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.2"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Authorities Suspend Three Rights Groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups","summary":"Abiy publicly praised reforms such as media freedom and NGO registration while the government suspended major rights groups and rolled back civic space. This is strong rhetoric-versus-practice evidence.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.7","7B.2"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Journalist arrested under state of emergency: Belay Manaye","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr25/7782/2024/en/","summary":"a journalist was detained for reporting on the Amhara conflict, showing the state using emergency powers to suppress unwelcome reporting rather than expose tradeoffs.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"EHRCO staff were detained and forcibly disappeared while investigating forced evictions, which directly suggests retaliation against people documenting state actions.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels","publisher":"Ethiopian Human Rights Commission / Reuters","date":"2024-02-27","url":"https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/","summary":"the EHRC head confirmed the secret “Koree Nageenyaa” committee existed and interfered in the justice system. That points to hidden decision-making and opaque coercive governance, not open adherence to formal commitments.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.7"]},{"title":"Freedom House Ethiopia 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-net/2024","summary":"authorities restricted mobile internet, disrupted access during fighting, restricted social media, and used the state of emergency to detain journalists without charge. This is evidence of manipulating information to manage political costs.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.6","7B.7","7B.2"]}]}
